bind_port.description: UDP port miredo binds to — some firewall/NAT setups require a specific one; unset lets the system pick.

interface_name.description: Name of the tunneling network interface miredo creates.

relay_type.description: Operating mode: client (the default when unset), autoclient, relay, cone or restricted.

server_address.description: Hostname or IPv4 address of the Teredo server (client mode).
